scope: Software and supplied simulations; no hardware or physical deployment
authorization: User approved HOPE-V2-Simulation-Verification-Plan.md after accepting recorded latency and requiring coverage investigation before runtime changes

timing.new_excursions: Record and assess effect on consumer usability; do not automatically waive expiry or missed contact

coverage.denominator: Independent offered source opportunities and physical flights, including lost deliveries
coverage.raw_observation_coverage: Diagnostic; retain the original >=95% verdict separately
coverage.incoming: One immutable correctly decoded usable command per independently offered valid flight
coverage.existing_backend: Evaluate per-flight usable command and required revision/revocation behavior separately from per-observation coverage
coverage.no_change_condition: Demonstrated existing same-flight valid command meets the simulator/consumer contract; no concealed invalidation or missing required update
coverage.fix_condition: Demonstrated lost usable command, incorrect conversion, or obsolete authority
coverage.unknown_condition: INCONCLUSIVE; do not infer harmlessness from a rejection reason

simulation_tolerances.rationale_conversion: Adapter/decoder numerical equality with the selected physical contact, allowing floating-point epoch representation
simulation_tolerances.rationale_truth: One modeled ball radius and half the existing 50 Hz Runner tick; declared before new scored runs; software simulation criteria only
simulation_tolerances.rationale_managed_legacy: Existing RacketTargetPlanner uses a separate 1 ms integrator; assess its simulated landing within one ball radius and half a Runner tick, while retaining the stricter independent ValidatedReturnPlanner gate above
simulation_tolerances.managed_legacy_impact: Use speed-dependent restitution .759*exp(-.0441*approach), clamped to [.2,.95]; report the three-iteration solver residual and test the independently reconstructed outgoing landing
simulation_tolerances.prefix_availability: A physical scenario must yield a usable command at a declared supported cutoff; an earlier uncertain prefix must abstain with independently checked uncertainty evidence. This does not substitute a later retry for a missing command in a committed ROS flight.
simulation_tolerances.continuous_preview_truth_errors: Report all errors by source cutoff; do not substitute an early preview for the committed-command criterion
